metadata.description: Skills for coding agents: get a repo ready for Show HN, write a Napkin-style book, run jobs on Google Colab without wasting units

plugins.name: hn-ready
plugins.description: Get a project ready for a Show HN launch: one-command install, short README, logo, real demo GIF, CI and a launch kit

plugins.name: writing-napkin-books
plugins.description: Write a long, readable, fact-checked book on any topic in the style of Evan Chen's Napkin: LaTeX template, build and check tools, agent briefs

plugins.name: colab-browser
plugins.description: Run GPU jobs on Google Colab through a browser the user signs in to: notebooks that finish and release their runtime on their own, a watch loop that stops idle runtimes, and checks before stopping anything
